notes: Feature-first eval set covering the iOS skill's capability surface (S2S out of scope this iteration), structured so a shared cross-platform harness can consume it. Each integration eval is run against a fresh copy of a blank SwiftUI app (fixtures/ios-app) that builds clean BEFORE integration; the agent integrates via the package manager named in the prompt. Install method is a FULL axis evaluated equally: every integration capability (basic interstitial, rewarded+revenue+errors, banner/MREC, privacy, AdMob-mediation) is tested under BOTH CocoaPods and SPM as separate, paired evals, each prompt naming its manager so the manager is deterministic and graded (dependency + build-gate assertions). CocoaPods is the skill's documented default and most-used path, but both are first-class test targets with equal coverage. The detection evals (13-16) cover existing-CocoaPods (use it), existing-SPM (use it), neither-present (ASK the user and recommend CocoaPods — do not silently default), and both-present (ASK which path to use; never switch the project's managers). The headline assertion for every (non-parked) integration eval is that the produced app COMPILES on the simulator via xcodebuild ('** BUILD SUCCEEDED **') on the matching build gate. The skill's iOS API was verified against the real SDK (BidMachinePlus 0.1.0, which vends InterstitialAd/RewardedAd/BannerAd); the banner/MREC pair (evals 4, 5) tests BannerAd at MREC (.mrec). The fixture uses objectVersion 77 / file-system-synchronized groups and REQUIRES Xcode 16+. The Plus coordinates are the BidMachinePlus CocoaPods pod and the BidMachinePlus-SPM Swift package (Swift module import BidMachinePlus) — the only dependency names the evals/skill use. The SKAdNetworkItems list remains a placeholder. The released 0.1.0 public coordinates (pod BidMachinePlus, SPM BidMachinePlus-SPM, sources) live in references/distribution.md. Prompts give no version. Mediator is never an organizing axis and never a pass/fail gate — only the AdMob-mediation evals (8, 9) expect with(mediator:), and only as analytics. The process evals — checklist-step-order (10), explore-project-first (11), ask-questions-before-editing (12) — and the detection evals (13-16) are graded from the run transcript. Because the skill mandates asking clarifying questions first, integration evals are run with those answers supplied so headless runs don't stall; eval 12 gets none, to test the asking itself. Schema is shared-harness compatible: a common harness reads id/name/prompt/expected_output/files/assertions; the iOS-only keys (fixture, fixture_setup, install_method, process_expectations, build_gate, verifier_expectation, notes) are additive and ignored by the common path.

build_gates.spm: xcodebuild -project DemoApp.xcodeproj -scheme DemoApp -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -resolvePackageDependencies && xcodebuild -project DemoApp.xcodeproj -scheme DemoApp -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
build_gates.cocoapods: pod install && xcodebuild -workspace DemoApp.xcworkspace -scheme DemoApp -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
